```{r setup}
library(SigBridgeR)
```

## Load Data

To load spatial transcriptomics (e.g., Xenium) data, you first need to register the corresponding loading function in `SCPreProcess`, as these functions are not natively built into the package.

```{r,registering ,eval = FALSE}
Register(x = Seurat::LoadXenium)
```

```{r,registering2,eval=FALSE}
# ℹ Auto-detected registry: SCPreProcessStrategy
# ✔ Registered x
```

```{r,check,eval = FALSE}
names(SCPreProcessStrategy)
```

```{r,check2,eval=FALSE}
# [1] "t" "u" "v" "x" "c" "e" "i" "n" "o" "p" "r" "s"
```

Then preprocess the data.

```{r,eval=FALSE}
seurat <- SCPreProcess(
  sc
)
```
